items.briefing:
Australian organisations using home or small-scale battery energy systems should be aware these devices are now subject to cybersecurity compliance requirements, following new regulatory guidance. If your organisation or staff work with such equipment, it's worth checking whether compliance obligations apply to you.

Separately, Scamwatch has issued new alerts relevant to Australians — staff should remain cautious about unsolicited contacts via phone, email, or text. Scammers continue to target individuals and workplaces, particularly impersonating trusted organisations.

**Practical tip:** Check the Scamwatch website (scamwatch.gov.au) regularly and report any suspicious messages you or your colleagues receive.
